observed_at_note: Local observation date only. No wall-clock timestamp was captured at the time of the checkpoint; recorded as the campaign date rather than invented.
execution_mode: interactive local session, filesystem and shell tools on the enrolled workstation

git.note: The module rename was committed on the predecessor branch and merged into the successor so each PR stays reviewable on its own. No merge to main and no self-merge was performed by this agent.

model.note: The agent tool surface did not expose model identity, context size or quota. The desktop model selector was not treated as an independently verified runtime identity.

source.attribution_limitations: Usage is shared with a human-operated account and cannot be attributed per campaign from the client. No telemetry source exposes per-campaign consumption.

measurements_note: No token counters, quota windows or reset epochs were exposed to this agent. Measurements are an empty list with an explicit gap rather than zero values.
